properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "imagemagick" or CommandLine contains "policy" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1755
